capabilities: Export a note to a single HTML file
Embed images and formulas as Base64
Generate a table of contents that highlights the current section
Add line numbers and copy buttons to code blocks
extras: Templates v2 and v3 include light/dark themes, mobile layouts and a collapsible outline; the interface language follows Chinese or English automatically. Demo pages for all three templates are linked from the README.
problem: Notes shared or archived outside Obsidian lose their images, formulas and styling unless everything is packed into a single portable file.

relations.evidence: mirrors the reading layout of an Obsidian Fast Note Sync share page

summary: Exporter that turns a note into one self-contained HTML file with embedded images, KaTeX formulas and styles.
